description.text: Program Introduction: This major is trained to master the basic theory and knowledge and skills of electrical automation, and the advanced technical professionals engaged in industrial electrical control equipment and system installation, design, debugging, maintenance and technical management. Training objective: Training and mastering the basic theory and knowledge and skills of electrical automation, and advanced technical professionals engaged in industrial electrical control equipment and system installation, design, debugging, maintenance and technical management. The students of this specialty should have the engineering technology foundation and certain professional knowledge of electrical technology, electronic technology, control theory, automatic detection and instrument, information processing, system engineering, computer technology and application and network technology. It can be used in motion control, industrial process control, power electronics technology. Senior engineering technicians in the fields of system analysis, system design, system operation, scientific and Technological Development and research in the fields of testing and automation instruments, electronic and computer technology, information processing, management and decision-making. Main course: Electrician foundation, electronic technology, electric motor drive foundation, power electronics technology, factory power supply technology, factory electrical control technology, automatic control system, single chip computer and interface technology, PLC technology application, detection technology, computer control technology Duration: 4 years

duration.text: The Electrical Engineering and Automation at Dalian University of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2847 USD/per year ￥ 20500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Academic transcript of high school 5.HSK Certificate (Optional)

requirements.text: Applicants must 1. Hold a high school degree 2. Be in good health 3. Over the age of 18
